output.summary: Add a transaction limit field to the card settings panel to allow users to set a maximum transaction amount for their cards.
acceptance: The transaction limit field is visible in the card settings panel.
The field accepts numeric input and displays an error message if non-numeric input is entered.
The field updates the card's transaction limit when the user submits the form.
The card's transaction limit is updated on the server via the PATCH /cards/{id} endpoint.
The card's transaction limit is reflected in the card's details on the CardsPage.
outOfScope: Changing the layout or design of the card settings panel.
Adding new features or functionality outside of the transaction limit field.
Modifying the behavior of existing components like Panel, Toggle, or FreezeCardToggle.
